name: Gasthof Ölberg
beschreibung: The Gasthof Ölberg is located in the Austrian state of Tirol and is classified as a hotel. The establishment has a traditional décor and follows an Alpine style. The rooms are equipped with a bathroom, WC, and some with a balcony. The restaurant serves mainly regional and Austrian dishes. The surroundings are rural and surrounded by mountains. Guests can use Wi-Fi and parking. The atmosphere is quiet and down-to-earth. There are hiking trails and winter sports opportunities in the nearby area.
